mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting cytosolic ATP production with oxygen was most worthwhile: the illustration plan distinguishes fuel oxidation from oxygen's role and links the hydrogen-ion gradient to ATP synthase.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the cell interior after glycolysis was least worthwhile: the pyruvate arrows suggested that location, but the game instead required the oxygen item.

surprise.text: The protein-production goal appeared after aerobic ATP renewal, and its final construction showed both ATP- and GTP-supported steps using existing RNA messages.

arbitrary.text: The failed cell-interior pairing felt somewhat arbitrary because the pictured pyruvate was heading toward mitochondria inside that hotspot; the compatibility feedback supplied the intended oxygen partner.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the membrane transport and ATP constructions make useful contrasts, though I would want similarly clear explanations of new terms and connections.
